description: This file defines the SystemConfigSubscriber class, which subscribes to configuration events in Drupal to handle theme changes, validate configuration imports, and ensure site UUID consistency.

classes.name: SystemConfigSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class for handling system configuration events in Drupal, including theme changes and configuration validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that injects the RouteBuilderInterface service.

methods.name: onConfigSave
methods.description: Rebuilds the router when the system theme configuration changes.

methods.name: onConfigImporterValidateNotEmpty
methods.description: Prevents configuration import if the source is empty, to avoid deleting all configuration.

methods.name: onConfigImporterValidateSiteUUID
methods.description: Validates that the site UUID in source and target match during configuration import.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the array of events this class subscribes to, with associated callback methods.
